Using the determinant formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 3 & -4 & 1 \\ -2 & 5 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-4 & 1 \\ 5 & 6\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -2 & 6\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}3 & -4 \\ -2 & 5\end{aligned}|k \\  & =((-4)(6)-(1)(5))i-((3)(6)-(1)(-2))j+((3)(5)-(-4)(-2))k \\  & =(-24-5)i-(18+2)j+(15-8)k \\  & =-29\,i-20\,j+7\,k\end{aligned}
$$
